label: Center of mass formula
subgoals: Set up both integrals with the density

slice.rule: A rod on $[a, b]$ with density $\rho(x)$ balances at $\bar{x} = \dfrac{\int_a^b x\,\rho(x)\,dx}{\int_a^b \rho(x)\,dx}$: the moment about the origin divided by the total mass.
If $\rho$ is constant it cancels from the quotient, and the centre of mass is the midpoint $\bar{x} = \dfrac{a + b}{2}$ whatever the density.

label: Variable density
subgoals: Integrate x times rho and rho separately
Expect the balance point toward the heavy end
Check the answer lies inside the rod

slice.rule: With density that grows along the rod the balance point shifts toward the heavy end; always compute both integrals and check $a \le \bar{x} \le b$.
